description: This file defines the CustomerAttribute entity class in a Java application, used for representing customer attributes in a database instance within the SalesManager project. It includes entity mappings, relationships with Customer, CustomerOption, and CustomerOptionValue, and getters/setters.

classes.name: CustomerAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing customer attributes, with fields for ID, associated customer, customer options, and text value, mapping to the CUSTOMER_ATTRIBUTE table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the CustomerAttribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the CustomerAttribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOption for this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOptionValue for this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the Customer for this attribute.

methods.name: getTextValue
methods.description: Returns the text value of the attribute.

methods.name: setTextValue
methods.description: Sets the text value of the attribute.
